title: Multimodal Visual Token Pruning & Compression Selection: Progressive Layer-Wise FastV/PyramidDrop vs. Unpruned Tiling & Pre-LLM Resamplers

workload_basis.input_modality: 4K Multi-Page Document / 32-Frame Video (8,192 Raw Visual Patches)
workload_basis.eval_benchmark: Enterprise DocVQA + ChartQA + Video-MME Composite Accuracy

tiers.tier: Tier 1: Unpruned Dynamic High-Res Tiling (8,192 Visual Tokens Kept Across All 80 Layers)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Baseline when latency and KV Cache memory are unconstrained

tiers.tier: Tier 2: Fixed 64-Token Pre-LLM Perceiver Resampler (Drop 92% Before LLM Layer 1)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Coarse natural-image captioning only (destroys fine-grained OCR, tables & numbers!)

tiers.tier: Tier 3: 2x2 Pixel-Shuffle / Token Merging (ToMe) Before LLM (Keep 100% Across 80 Layers)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Standard Qwen2.5-VL / InternVL 2x2 spatial patch merging

tiers.tier: Tier 4 (Recommended): 2x2 Merger + Progressive Layer-Wise Attention Pruning (FastV / PyramidDrop: 100% L1-2 -> 50% L3-16 -> 20% L17-80)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Production high-res Document/Video VLM serving (3.8x faster TTFT, -77.9% KV Cache, 94.0% accuracy)
